title: Operator-Valued Q-Learning: Compositional Bellman Recursions for Order-Sensitive Decision Making
abstract: arXiv:2611.30255v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In quantum pulse sequences, spacecraft attitude control and in-hand reorientation, actions act on a hidden physical state as non-commuting operators, so the outcome of a plan depends on the order of its actions. We let the value function carry this structure: each Q(s,a) is an N x N operator, and the Bellman backup applies the action's dual map to the continuation value, Q(s,a) = K_a^*(R(s,a) + gamma E V(s')). Unrolled along a plan, the recursion builds the ordered product of the actions' operators, and the value at any latent state is a linear trace readout. It is exact for policies that do not observe the latent, the backup contracts for unitary and orthogonal dynamics, and an asynchronous operator TD scheme learns it with almost-sure convergence. Classical values live in a lattice, so a maximum over actions exists; self-adjoint operators form an anti-lattice (Kadison) and have none. An operator log-sum-exp still gives one operator per

translated_title: 算子值Q学习：面向顺序敏感决策的组合式贝尔曼递归
translated_abstract: 在量子脉冲序列、航天器姿态控制以及手内物体重定向等任务中，动作以不可交换算子的形式作用于隐藏的物理状态，因此一个计划的结果取决于其动作的执行顺序。我们让价值函数承载这一结构：每个 Q(s,a) 是一个 N×N 算子，贝尔曼回溯将动作的对偶映射作用于后续价值，即 Q(s,a) = K_a^*(R(s,a) + γ E V(s'))。沿一个计划展开时，该递归构建动作算子的有序乘积，而任意潜在状态处的价值是一个线性迹读出。该递归对于不观测潜在状态的策略是精确的，回溯在酉动力学和正交动力学下是压缩的，并且一种异步算子时序差分（TD）方案可以以几乎必然收敛的方式学习它。经典价值存在于格结构中，因此动作上的最大值存在；而自伴算子构成一个反格（Kadison），不存在这样的最大值。算子化的 log-sum-exp 仍能为每个……给出一个算子（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出算子值Q学习，将Q值表示为矩阵算子，通过保持不可交换动作算子有序乘积的贝尔曼递归，实现对顺序敏感决策问题的精确价值估计，并给出压缩性保证与几乎必然收敛的异步算子TD学习方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes operator-valued Q-learning, in which Q-values are N×N operators and the Bellman recursion preserves the ordered product of non-commuting action operators, yielding exact value estimates for order-sensitive decision-making, contraction guarantees for unitary/orthogonal dynamics, and an asynchronous operator TD scheme with almost-sure convergence.
